-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SimpleFeature } from "./features-simple.types";

  export type FeaturesSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    items: SimpleFeature[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    layout?: "stack" | "aside";
    cols?: "2" | "3" | "4";
    marker?: "top" | "inline";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };

  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";

  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    items,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    layout = "stack",
    cols = "3",
    marker = "top",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FeaturesSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");

    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const frame = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "aside" ? "md:grid md:grid-cols-3 md:items-start"
    : ""
  );
  const grid = $derived(
    ((layout as string) === "aside") && ((cols as string) === "2") ? "md:col-span-2"
    : (layout as string) === "aside" ? "md:col-span-2 md:grid-cols-3"
    : (cols as string) === "2" ? "md:grid-cols-2"
    : (cols as string) === "3" ? "md:grid-cols-3"
    : "md:grid-cols-4"
  );
  const item = $derived(
    (marker as string) === "inline" ? "flex flex-row items-start gap-4"
    : (align as string) === "center" ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-4"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "flex flex-col items-end gap-4"
    : "flex flex-col items-start gap-4"
  );
  const copyAlign = $derived(
    (marker as string) === "inline" ? "start"
    : (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const copyText = $derived(

    : (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"

<Block

  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}

>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="12" align="stretch" class={frame}>

        <Title as={level} size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>

        {/if}

      <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 list-none p-0", cn("grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2", grid))}>
        {#each items as f (f.id)}
          <ListItem class={item} data-slot="feature">
            <MediaFrame alt={f.title} src={f.image} ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-full" />

                {f.title}

              {#if f.description}

              {/if}
